thread:
Lina (CS): PulseCare (pilot) pinged asking for a quick config change: temporary rate increase for sa-east-1 (Brazil) for demo day, IP allowlist for their cloud NAT, and preference routing to sa-east-1. They want auto-revoke after 96 hours. Launch blocking for their demo next Tue.

Diego (Networking): Can we get the exact NAT IPs and whether they're coming from a fixed egress? Also want to confirm TLS termination expectations.

Lina (CS): Provided 186.75.20.0/24. Egress is fixed. No new certs needed, they'll use standard API keys. Duration: 96h starting 2026-04-12T14:00Z. Requested sustained 1,500 rpm per customer token.

Maya (Account): Heads-up: renewal touchpoint after pilot. If demo fails, upsell odds drop. Recommend strict spend cap and daily usage report to the customer. Finance, can we set an alert?

Finance: We can add a $600/day spend alert and a hard cap at $1,200 total for the 96h window. Confirming with billing.

Sam (Onboarding): I'll run the demo Wed 10:00 BRT. Need SDK key scoped to the temp profile + a small sample dataset. Also please provide fallback guidance if we hit qps limits mid-demo.

ops-oncall: 1.5k rpm is OK for redwood-llama-s-7b for short bursts, but if they use long seq lengths concurrency matters. Recommend enabling prefix caching and a conservative concurrency throttle (10 concurrent requests max) for the profile.

Diego (Networking): Plan: add 186.75.20.0/24 to customer allowlist, create rate_profile pulsecare-demo with max_rpm:1500 expiry:2026-04-16T14:00Z auto_revoke:true routing_preference:sa-east-1 concurrency_limit:10. Will stage change in canary first and post ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket #CS-4927 opened: "PulseCare - sa-east-1 demo lift + allowlist" assigned to Diego. State: review queued.

Lina (CS): Please ensure auto-revoke is enforced and that we notify the customer 12h before rollback. Also add a note to the renewal tracker: "PulseCare - pilot demo 4/12; temp rate lift; spend cap in place; renewal at-risk if demo fails."

Diego (Networking): Will do. I'll also attach an operational playbook snippet for Sam: how to force-failover to eu-west-1 fallback and how to switch to a quantized 4-bit variant if latency spikes.

Maya (Account): Thanks. I'll message the customer with the tentative approval (subject to infra applying ACL). Will ask them to limit concurrent sessions during demo.

Lina (CS): Perfect. Ping here when ACL is live and when the temp API key is created. I'll collect feedback post-demo and share any evals for Optimize.
